tasks.why: Clean the bedside table first so the remote and pill organiser can go on a clean surface.
The remote sits on a low footstool your mother can no longer reach; it is lifted to be put somewhere within her reach.
The towel on the bath edge is too low for her; it is picked up to be put away.
The pill organiser is brought from the kitchen counter to her; it stays in the home, so it is not taken out of the building.
